text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Nymark Avenue, between Bellbury Crescent and Glentworth Road.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item until the April 30, 2025 meeting of the North York Community Council.
